choices.text: Khoảng cách từ điểm <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>D</mi></mrow></semantics></math> đến mặt phẳng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> bằng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></semantics></math>

Mặt phẳng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> có phương trình <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>5</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>

variants.solution: Mặt cầu <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> có tâm <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>I</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mn>0</mn><mo>;</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>;</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> và bán kính <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>R</mi><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mn>14</mn></msqrt></mrow></semantics></math>. Mặt phẳng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> có phương trình <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>6</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math>, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>D</mi><mo>,</mo><mo>(</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>B</mi><mi>C</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mn>6</mn></mrow></semantics></math>, đường thẳng <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>d</mi></mrow></semantics></math> đi qua tâm <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mi>I</mi></mrow></semantics></math> nên cắt <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="inline"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>S</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow></mrow></semantics></math> tại 2 điểm phân biệt.
